description: This Dart source file defines the BudgetsProvider class, which manages a list of budget models, acts as a simple cache, and interfaces with a BudgetRepository for CRUD operations within a Flutter application.

classes.name: BudgetsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages budget data, provides caching, and interfaces with the BudgetRepository.

methods.name: BudgetsProvider
methods.description: Constructor which initializes the repository, optionally with a custom repository instance.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads budgets asynchronously, optionally scoped by category and period, updating the cache.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new budget via the repository, adds it to the cache, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget via the repository and updates the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a budget by ID via the repository and updates the cache.
